description: St. Laurenzen stands on the Marktgasse in St. Gallen, a town church with one neo-Gothic spire and a nave roof of colored glazed tiles. The tower is a single square-then-octagon helm, not the abbey’s pair of baroque towers. Windows stay dark. This replaces the abbey west front, already published. The Open-Meteo model is mostly cloudy and cool, about 12°C, with cloud cover near seven-tenths, humid air, a light wind, and no precipitation, and the sun is below the horizon.
